sloka: रामो ऽपि रेमे तैः सार्धं वानरैः कामरूपिभिः ।राक्षसैश्च महावीर्यैर्ऋक्षैश्चैव महाबलैः ।। ७.३९.२८ ॥
transliteration: rāmo 'pi reme taiḥ sārdhaṁ vānaraiḥ kāmarūpibhiḥ ।rākṣasaiśca mahāvīryairṛkṣaiścaiva mahābalaiḥ ।। 7.39.28 ॥

translations.english: Rama also delighted in the company of those form-changing monkeys, the greatly valorous Rakshasas, and the exceedingly strong bears.
translations.hindi: ह त ह र उठ खड़े हुए और बोले .. हृ ! युद्ध करने के लिये तः च समय खोजा हे
